text.content:
The MaxTac commander who held the receipts.

Role: Commander of MaxTac in 2047
Affiliation: MaxTac
Known for: Coordinating the Static Night crew; folding MaxTac back into the NCPD

In 2047 Hammerman commanded MaxTac, then an independent tactical agency. When the city's leaders wouldn't act on Static Night, a few of them went off the books, and Hammerman was the man between the groups: the city leaders, the crew, the badges and whoever else was in the room. He made sure the right people were in the same place and didn't shoot each other, and gave the crew a MaxTac squad of its own.

When the second Purge Ordinance handed MaxTac a fat contract that would have made it the Council's private police, Hammerman turned it inside out: MaxTac rejoined the NCPD, and the NCPD became the city's one legal enforcement agency.

GM secrets

Lyle Thompson's assumption, and the only explanation he finds that fits: Hammerman knew who hired the crew, who paid the contractors and who was in the room on Static Night, and made sure the Council knew he knew.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02
